visual_form.spatial_logic: A single focal mark, body, light, or proposition isolated before relation or system forms.
visual_form.figure_ground: One clear figure against generous ground.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Two poles mirror, oppose, choose, or answer across one charged interval.
visual_form.figure_ground: Both poles and the space between them must remain legible.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Two established terms produce a visible third term, direction, or shared space.
visual_form.figure_ground: The emergent third may appear in negative space rather than as another object.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A stable frame, grid, room, platform, or four-corner system visibly holds the image together.
visual_form.figure_ground: Boundary and interior are equally meaningful.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A stable pattern is cracked, displaced, interrupted, misregistered, or invaded by an incompatible force.
visual_form.figure_ground: The anomaly or fracture becomes active negative space.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A disrupted field is rerouted, counterweighted, negotiated, or reconfigured into a workable new relation without returning to its old symmetry.
visual_form.figure_ground: The repaired relation is visible as a changed path, not an erased wound.

visual_form.composition_law: A system or figure turns back upon its own representation.
visual_form.spatial_logic: Mirror, map, monitor, diagram, shadow, or recursive frame makes the subject inspect itself from within the scene.
visual_form.figure_ground: Figure and representation/reflection both read; neither fully replaces the other.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A sequence of hands, tools, steps, repeated marks, or moving bodies shows energy being applied toward a concrete transformation.
visual_form.figure_ground: Process marks remain visible enough to show how the result is being made.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Many elements accumulate into a mature abundant field while preserving one coherent center, interval, or breath.
visual_form.figure_ground: Abundance surrounds rather than obliterates the focal relation.

visual_form.spatial_logic: The full system spills, hands off, loops, multiplies, or crosses the boundary that once contained it.
visual_form.figure_ground: The frame itself becomes insufficient and the excess points toward the next cycle.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A watcher, notebook, camera, window, or frame-within-frame is offset from the event and makes the act of looking visible.
visual_form.figure_ground: Observed scene and observing position remain distinctly separated.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A central figure uses costume, pose, prop, or proscenium to project confidence larger than the private self behind it.
visual_form.figure_ground: The gap between performed scale and actual human scale should remain subtly visible.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A solitary figure is small against horizon, wilderness, empty room, or social distance; baggage or a long shadow may carry what cannot be left behind.
visual_form.figure_ground: Negative space is the principal pressure on the figure.

visual_form.composition_law: Authentic presence coordinates the whole field.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A full-height embodied figure stands among others and helps organize shared movement without becoming separate from the group.
visual_form.figure_ground: The figure belongs to the collective composition even while carrying clear presence.
